display.purpose: The typed uppercase list title at the top of each sheet; an editable input styled as typed capitals.

headline.purpose: h1 blocks typed on the sheet; uppercase with 0.07em tracking.

title.purpose: h2 blocks and the auth form subtitle; uppercase with 0.05em tracking.

body.purpose: Todos, paragraphs, placeholders, and empty states. The 1.9 leading is the typewriter's line spacing and gives the strike room to draw.

label.purpose: Uppercase Courier Prime for everything around the paper: buttons (700 weight, 0.1em), filter tabs, field labels, session strip, hints.

shadows.name: paper
shadows.purpose: Every paper surface resting on the desk: contact edge plus soft drop.

shadows.name: stacked-sheet
shadows.purpose: The rotated paper-shade sheets underneath a sheet-stack.

shadows.name: menu-scrap
shadows.purpose: The slash-menu paper scrap, hovering slightly closer than the sheet.

shadows.name: desk-vignette
shadows.purpose: Ambient darkening at the desk's edges (background layer, not a box-shadow).

motion.name: sheet-settle
motion.purpose: A sheet entering the desk: drops ~10px and un-rotates 0.3 degrees into place.

motion.name: strike-draw
motion.purpose: The red completion strike drawing left-to-right via stroke-dashoffset (pathLength 100).

motion.name: menu-in
motion.purpose: The slash-menu scrap fading up 3px at 0.99 scale.

motion.name: micro
motion.purpose: Button ink-fill hover and margin-tool reveal.

motion.name: stack-shift
motion.purpose: Sidebar sheet straightening and sliding right on selection (transition-transform).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables all animations and transitions; the strike renders fully drawn

textures.name: grain
textures.value: inline SVG feTurbulence (fractalNoise 0.9, 2 octaves) at 5% alpha, 240x240 tile — var(--grain)

textures.name: linen
textures.value: inline SVG feTurbulence (fractalNoise 0.08 0.4, 2 octaves) at 5% alpha, 200x200 tile — var(--linen)

components.name: Typed Button
components.description: A typed label stamped in a thin frame; inverts to ink fill on hover, presses 1px on active.
components.css: .ds-typed-btn { font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s ease-out, color 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-typed-btn:hover { background: var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); color: var(--paper, oklch(0.965 0.012 95)); border-color: var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); } .ds-typed-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-typed-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px dashed var(--pencil, oklch(0.48 0.01 80)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ribbon Button (destructive)
components.description: The typed button in ribbon red for destructive acts — 'Tear up' a sheet.
components.css: .ds-typed-btn-ribbon { font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 0.625rem; color: var(--ribbon, oklch(0.5 0.17 27)); background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s ease-out, color 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-typed-btn-ribbon:hover { background: var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); color: var(--paper, oklch(0.965 0.012 95)); border-color: var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); } .ds-typed-btn-ribbon:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px dashed var(--pencil, oklch(0.48 0.01 80)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Typed Input
components.description: A line on the page you type onto: underline-only field, typewriter face, ink caret.
components.css: .ds-typed-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-typed-field-label { font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--ink-faded, oklch(0.54 0.012 80)); } .ds-typed-input { font-family: 'Special Elite', 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.9375rem; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink-faint, oklch(0.7 0.012 85)); border-radius: 0; padding: 0.25rem 0.125rem; color: var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); caret-color: var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); } .ds-typed-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faded, oklch(0.54 0.012 80)); } .ds-typed-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); }

components.name: Paper Sheet
components.description: The material every surface is made of: grained warm-white paper resting on a slim stack, casting the paper shadow.
components.html:
Errands

Pick up the dry cleaning
components.css: .ds-sheet-stack { position: relative; max-width: 20rem; } .ds-sheet-stack::before, .ds-sheet-stack::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--paper-shade, oklch(0.93 0.014 95)); border-radius: 1px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.25); z-index: -1; } .ds-sheet-stack::before { transform: rotate(0.5deg) translate(3px, 2px); } .ds-sheet-stack::after { transform: rotate(-0.4deg) translate(-2px, 4px); } .ds-paper { background-color: var(--paper, oklch(0.965 0.012 95)); background-image: var(--grain); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); border-radius: 1px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.2), 0 14px 34px -10px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.4); padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem; } .ds-paper-title { font-family: 'Special Elite', 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.25rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin: 0; } .ds-paper-rule { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.27 0.015 80 / 0.25); margin: 0.5rem 0 1rem; } .ds-paper-line { font-family: 'Special Elite', 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.9; margin: 0; }

components.name: Struck Task Line (signature)
components.description: A completed to-do: no checkbox — a wavering ribbon-red SVG stroke drawn over faded-ink typewriter text.
components.html: Water the plants
components.css: .ds-struck-line { position: relative; display: inline-block; font-family: 'Special Elite', 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.9; color: var(--ink-faded, oklch(0.54 0.012 80)); } .ds-strike { position: absolute; top: 0; left: -4px; width: calc(100% + 8px); height: 1.9em; pointer-events: none; } .ds-strike path { stroke: var(--ribbon, oklch(0.5 0.17 27)); stroke-width: 1.75; fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 100; stroke-dashoffset: 100; animation: ds-strike-draw 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards; } @keyframes ds-strike-draw { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-strike path { animation: none; stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }

components.name: Slash Menu
components.description: The '/' block menu: a scrap of grained paper listing the five core blocks with pencil icons and desk-label markdown hints.
components.css: .ds-menu-paper { width: 14rem; background-color: var(--paper, oklch(0.965 0.012 95)); background-image: var(--grain); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); border: 1px solid var(--paper-edge, oklch(0.88 0.016 95)); border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.18), 0 12px 28px -8px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.4); padding: 0.375rem 0; animation: ds-menu-in 0.12s ease-out; } @keyframes ds-menu-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(3px) scale(0.99); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } } .ds-menu-row { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; background: transparent; border: 0; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; color: inherit; } .ds-menu-row-active, .ds-menu-row:hover { background: oklch(0.27 0.015 80 / 0.08); } .ds-menu-icon { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--ink-faded, oklch(0.54 0.012 80)); } .ds-menu-label { font-family: 'Special Elite', 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; flex: 1; } .ds-menu-hint { font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-faded, oklch(0.54 0.012 80)); }

components.name: Filter Tab with Pencil Ring
components.description: Desk-label filter tabs; the active one is circled by a hand-drawn pencil ellipse.
components.css: .ds-filter-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 1rem; } .ds-filter-tab { position: relative; font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--ink-faded, oklch(0.54 0.012 80)); background: transparent; border: 0; padding: 0.125rem 0.25rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-tab:hover, .ds-filter-tab-active { color: var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); } .ds-filter-tab:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px dashed var(--pencil, oklch(0.48 0.01 80)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-pencil-ring-svg { position: absolute; inset: -0.125rem -0.375rem; width: calc(100% + 0.75rem); height: calc(100% + 0.25rem); pointer-events: none; } .ds-pencil-ring-svg path { stroke: var(--pencil, oklch(0.48 0.01 80)); stroke-width: 1.25; fill: none; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }

components.name: Margin Tool
components.description: A hover-revealed pencil-mark affordance in the page margin: hidden at rest, revealed by row hover or focus; delete cross turns ribbon on hover.
components.html: Buy stamps
components.css: .ds-line-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-line-text { font-family: 'Special Elite', 'Courier Prime', monospace; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.9; color: var(--ink, oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); } .ds-line-tool { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink-faded, oklch(0.54 0.012 80)); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-line-row:hover .ds-line-tool, .ds-line-tool:focus-visible { opacity: 1; } .ds-line-tool:hover { color: var(--ribbon, oklch(0.5 0.17 27)); } .ds-line-tool:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px dashed var(--pencil, oklch(0.48 0.01 80)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-line-tool svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; } @media (hover: none) { .ds-line-tool { opacity: 0.6; } }

narrative.northStar: The Typed Sheet on the Desk
narrative.overview:
Every to-do list is a physical sheet of paper typed on an old writing machine, lying on a desk. The desk is the app chrome; the sheet is the interface. Nothing here looks like a program: there are no checkbox rows, no toolbars, no dialogs floating in a void. Editing happens on the page itself, affordances appear like pencil marks in the margin when the hand hovers a line, and finishing a task means drawing a ribbon-red stroke through it. The world reaches the whole app — the auth card is a typed sheet, the sidebar is a stack of sheets, even the loading copy speaks in desk language.

The system has exactly two materials and two voices. Materials: warm-white grained paper (everything you write on) and the desk beneath it (olive blotter by day, lamp-lit dark wood by night). Voices: Special Elite — the unsteady typewriter face — for everything typed on paper, and Courier Prime — uppercase, letterspaced — for desk labels and controls. Color is nearly monochrome ink-on-paper; the single chromatic accent is ribbon red, reserved for the strike, destructive actions, and error ink.

This build refuses the CRUD arrangement entirely (pinned direction, 2026-07-30). It is quiet, tactile, and paper-first: hand-drawn SVG strokes instead of geometric primitives, near-square corners, dashed pencil focus outlines, and motion that reads as paper settling and pen drawing rather than UI transitioning.
keyCharacteristics: Paper is the only surface; the desk is the only backdrop.
No checkboxes anywhere — completion is a red strike drawn over the line.
Two type voices: typewriter ink on paper, uppercase Courier desk labels.
One chromatic accent (ribbon red) with one job family: strike, destroy, error.
Affordances hide in the margins until hover/focus, like pencil marks.
Dark mode is a scene change (night desk under a lamp), not a palette inversion.

rules.name: The One Ribbon Rule
rules.body: Ribbon red is the only saturated color in the app, and it means exactly one family of things: crossed off, torn up, or gone wrong. Never use it decoratively.

rules.name: The No Pure Black Rule
rules.body: Ink is warm and soft (oklch(0.27 0.015 80)); shadows are the only place true black (as alpha) appears.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: If it's written on paper, it's Special Elite. If it labels the desk or a control, it's uppercase Courier Prime. No third font, no exceptions — including loading and error copy.

rules.name: The Uppercase Headings Rule
rules.body: Sheet headings (title, h1, h2) are uppercase with positive tracking, like typed capitals; body lines are sentence case.

rules.name: The Paper Casts Rule
rules.body: Only paper casts shadows. Buttons, inputs, icons, and text never carry their own box-shadow; they are marks on a surface, not surfaces.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: Paper is never flat color: every paper surface layers the shared --grain SVG turbulence texture; the desk layers --linen.

rules.name: The Drawn Line Rule
rules.body: Any line that represents a hand gesture — strike, ring, divider, icon stroke — is an SVG path with a wobble, never a straight CSS border or text-decoration.

dos: Do put every writable surface on .paper with the grain texture and the paper shadow; put every ambient label directly on the desk in desk voice.
Do draw completion as the ribbon strike (.strike-path + strike-draw) and fade struck text to --ink-faded — struck lines stay on the page and stay legible.
Do hide per-line actions with .line-tool until hover/focus-within, and keep them at resting opacity 0.6 on touch devices.
Do use .focus-pencil (1.5px dashed pencil outline, 3px offset) on every interactive element, and .typed-btn / .typed-input for controls — ink-inverting hover, underline-only fields.
Do confirm destruction in place, on the paper, in the world's language ("Tear up…?") — never in a modal.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: no settle, no menu-in, strike pre-drawn.
Do author new colors in OKLCH and give every token a night-desk value in .dark that re-lights the scene rather than inverting it.
donts: Don't render a checkbox, toggle, or tick mark anywhere — completion is the strike; this is a pinned product commitment.
Don't use ribbon red for anything but strike/destroy/error, and don't introduce a second accent color.
Don't use rounded corners beyond 3px, filled buttons at rest, boxed inputs, or drop shadows on non-paper elements.
Don't pull in an icon library or use straight CSS lines for strikes, dividers, or rings — drawn lines are wobbling SVG paths in the icon grammar.
Don't use a third typeface, non-uppercase desk labels, or text-decoration: line-through.
Don't open dialogs, drawers, or side panels for editing — the page is the interface; the slash menu's paper scrap is the only floating surface.
